title: Ultrasonically modified alumina industry waste-derived red mud beads coated with a Z-scheme Bi12O15Cl6/Fe2O3@C photocatalyst for enhanced degradation of antibiotics in wastewater
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2026, 13,563-581
DOI: 10.1039/D5EN00567A, Paper
Adarsh Singh, Ashok Kumar Gupta
Red mud was used to prepare surface-modified beads through alkali-assisted ultrasonication to immobilize a Z-scheme Bi12O15Cl6/Fe2O3@C heterostructure for the photocatalytic degradation of a norfloxacin and doxycycline mixture in a continuous-flow photocatalytic reactor.
